governing_acts: Fair Packaging and Labeling Act (FPLA, 15 U.S.C. 1451-1461)
NIST Handbook 130 (Uniform Packaging and Labeling Regulation - UPLR)

requirements.title: Dual Unit Net Quantity Declaration
requirements.target_rule: Both U.S. Customary (avoirdupois lb/oz or fl oz) AND SI Metric (g/kg or ml/L) declarations are mandatory under FPLA Section 4(a)(2).
requirements.indian_rule: Under Indian LMPC Rule 13, only standard SI metric units (g, kg, ml, l) are allowed; avoirdupois/imperial units are strictly prohibited.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Add U.S. Customary units alongside metric units (e.g., 'NET WT 14.1 OZ (400 g)' or '16.9 FL OZ (500 mL)').

requirements.title: Principal Display Panel (PDP) Location
requirements.target_rule: NIST Handbook 130 Section 8.1 requires net quantity declaration within the bottom 30% of the Principal Display Panel parallel to the base.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC Rule 6 permits net quantity anywhere on the Principal Display Panel as long as it satisfies minimum numeral font height.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Relocate net quantity declaration to the lower 30% of the front-facing Principal Display Panel.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Prohibition
requirements.target_rule: Government-mandated Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is illegal under U.S. antitrust and commercial law (Sherman Act & FTC Act); retailers set prices freely.
requirements.indian_rule: Mandatory declaration of Maximum Retail Price (MRP inclusive of all taxes) under LMPC Rule 6(1)(e); selling above MRP is a punishable offence.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Remove all 'MRP (incl. of all taxes)' markings. Optional Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) is permitted if clearly marked as suggested.

requirements.title: Statement of Identity
requirements.target_rule: 21 CFR 101.3 mandates statement of identity on the PDP bold, parallel to base, and prominent in terms of common or usual product name.
requirements.indian_rule: Common or generic name required on package under Rule 6(1)(b).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Ensure commodity name appears in prominent typography on front panel.

requirements.title: Business Name and Address
requirements.target_rule: 21 CFR 101.5 permits qualifying phrases such as 'Manufactured for [Name]' or 'Distributed by [Name]' with city, state, and zip code.
requirements.indian_rule: Rule 6(1)(a) mandates complete physical manufacturing/packing premises address with street name and PIN code.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Include U.S. distributor or importer name and city/state/zip on packaging.

requirements.title: Country of Origin Marking
requirements.target_rule: Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1304) strictly requires 'Product of India' or 'Made in India' conspicuously marked in English on all foreign articles.
requirements.indian_rule: Mandatory declaration of Country of Origin on imported products under Rule 6(1)(a) proviso.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Print 'Product of India' or 'Made in India' clearly near the distributor information.

requirements.title: Nutrition Facts Panel
requirements.target_rule: 21 CFR 101.9 mandates standardized FDA Nutrition Facts panel with serving size, calories, added sugars, vitamin D, calcium, iron, potassium.
requirements.indian_rule: Nutrition declaration governed primarily by FSSAI (energy, protein, carbs, total sugar, added sugar, fat, sodium).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Reformat nutritional values into FDA tabular 'Nutrition Facts' format with % Daily Values.

requirements.title: Major Food Allergen Declaration
requirements.target_rule: FASTER Act & FALCPA mandate declaration of 9 major allergens (Milk, Eggs, Fish, Crustacean Shellfish, Tree Nuts, Peanuts, Wheat, Soybeans, Sesame).
requirements.indian_rule: Allergen labeling specified under FSSAI Packaging & Labelling Regulations.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Explicitly identify sesame and major allergens in 'Contains: ...' statement.

requirements.title: Language Requirements
requirements.target_rule: 21 CFR 101.15 requires all mandatory label declarations to appear in the English language.
requirements.indian_rule: Permits English or Hindi in Devanagari script under Rule 9.
requirements.action_required_for_export: All declarations must be in English.
